# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large concatenation of real call recordings, but only a modest fraction are genuine **sales** conversations — enquiries, rate quotes, negotiation, and order confirmation. The majority of calls are internal-operations chatter: truck/trailer logistics with transporters (Raipur, Nagpur, Vizag, Tirupati routes), crane/loading coordination, MTC/tag/document handovers for QC, driver-payment disputes, and a long stretch of personal/non-business chat (the "Vishal" calls). These were excluded per instructions.

Genuine sales calls are concentrated around a handful of dealer/customer accounts: **Tirupati Balasubramaniam** (TMT dealer-to-dealer rate haggling), **V R Earth Movers**, **Vinayaga Steel Pradeep**, **Uniqcore Const Balakrishnan**, **Vadivel T S (Sangeetha Traders)**, **Vasudevan Ganesan/K**, **VJR Developers**, **Vimalkumar (Saveetha Institute)**, **Yashil Mayurkumar Shah**, **Thirisha Murugan**, and a few one-off enquiries (Vijay M, V Kumar, Vinoth Ramco, Vigneshwaran Kalidoss). Given the small real sample, conclusions below should be read as directional patterns, not statistically robust rules.

## Products & brand ladder

BSC is a **steel trading/stockist business**, not a manufacturer — confirmed repeatedly ("நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல," "வெளிய இருந்து source பண்றீங்களா"). Products actually discussed in sales calls:

- **TMT rebars (கம்பி)** — sizes 8mm–32mm; grades mentioned: FE500, 500D, 550D (RNL/RINL), E250, E350. Repeated line: *"500 கிடைக்காது sir... 550D தான் sir வரும்"* — FE500/500D are scarce; 550D is the standard offering.
- **Structural steel**: MS angle, channel (ISMC), ISMB (I-beam), plates, checkered plate, flat bars, high beams (e.g., "250 high beams").
- **Plates**: MS plate in multiple thicknesses (2mm–45mm), standard sheet sizes 2500x6300mm / "2.5 to 6300" stock format; cut-to-size service offered.
- **CR coil/sheet** (0.6mm) — BSC does not stock this itself; sales staff source via a known vendor and pass contact ("இருக்காங் sir, நான் number WhatsApp பண்றேன்").
- **Flat bars** — e.g., 100x5, 50x5, sold by "number" (piece) and length.
- **NOT dealt**: SHS/CHS pipes, square/rectangular pipes, bolts/hangers, net, washer — staff explicitly decline and redirect: *"pipes நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல Ma'am... direct-ஆ தான் source பண்ணுவீங்க."*

**Brand ladder** (as described to customers):
- **Sale (SAIL)** and **Vaisakh/Vizag (RINL)** are the two primary brands BSC stocks — "ரெண்டுமே same price தான் sir." Sale is usually the default; Vizag/Vaisakh offered when Sale unavailable.
- **Tata** appears only as a brand customers separately source/compare against (not BSC's core stock in most calls — "Tata-ல இல்லையா? இல்லை sir sale மட்டும் தான் இருக்கு").
- **NMDC** mentioned for plates as an alternative brand.
- Conversion/non-mill material ("conversion material," "local make") is explicitly flagged as lower-grade/variable and distinguished from branded mill material.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- Structural I-beam (250 high beam, Sale make): **₹62,500/ton + GST, loading, transport extra** — "60 to 500 per ton போயிட்டு இருக்கு sir இப்ப rate" (Thirisha Murugan call).
- ISMB 300x150 vs 300x140 comparison (V R Earth Movers): 300x150 = **₹60/kg**, 300x140 (heavier, 46kg/m) = **₹63/kg**, difference framed as ~₹3,000/ton; later in same thread rate moved to **₹61**, then **₹62–63** as market rose.
- Flat/channel structural quote (V Kumar, 5.5m length): opening ask ₹50–54/kg; vendor floor stated as **₹53.50/kg + GST + loading + transport**, down from an initial ₹54.
- UC structural steel (Uniqcore Const Balakrishnan): confirmed slab rates **₹71,750 / ₹73,750 / ₹75,750** (size-wise), "straight" cut, transport added separately; best-effort discount only **₹100–200/ton**.
- TMT (Vimalkumar, Saveetha Institute, 40-ton enquiry): **12mm ₹69/kg, 16mm ₹68.5/kg + GST extra** (GST not inclusive).
